test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".

The presidential election/ turned out to be one of/ the biggest landslide in history.

options.text: turned out to be one of

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error is in the part "**the biggest landslide in history".
 
• There should be plural form **of landslide** that is **landslides. It should be** "one of the biggest **landslides**" **instead of** "the biggest landslide."
 
• **This is because **when referring to one of a group or category, we use the indefinite article "a" or "an" rather than the definite article "the."

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *''The presidential election turned out to be one of **the biggest landslides in history**.'*
